isolation.statement: This first review used only the preregistered v2.5 workflow, schemas, gate manifest, draft inventory, local caption chain, and the two inventory validators authorized for debate 184.

findings.description: The draft quarter-four act at 01:30:03 answers an audience chat prompt whose text is absent from the transcript, so it cannot lock an exact prior opponent target without an artificial pairing.
Replacing the ineligible quarter-four act changes the slot's substantive source meaning and therefore requires exact relocking of its timestamp, event span, excerpt, and excerpt digest.
The eligible replacement act is owned by Eric Sampson on the pro side, rather than by Don Loeb on the con side as in the superseded draft slot.
The repaired slot needs a newly locked single-speaker atomic boundary around Sampson's self-undermining objection rather than retaining the superseded audience-response act.
The draft target packet forced Enoch's earlier criticism onto an act elicited by an unavailable audience question; the replacement act instead contacts Lutz's exact evidential-connection principle.
The error-not-permission distinction is a rhetorical implication-management point, not a necessary bridge on the adopted error-theory route, and it inflated the route graph.
Target 05 split explanatory idleness and undiminished explanation into duplicate indispensable contact units, which would overcount one conclusion in component-level classification.
Target 07 treated the concrete suffering example as a third indispensable component even though it only instantiates the constitution claim and perceptual analogy.
Target 09 redundantly split its positive conceptual-cognitive account and negative external-fact contrast into three overlapping indispensable contact units.
